title: Useless Items to feature
description: This is a mod that changes 5 useless items to features. And the items are Beacon, Clock, Heart of Sea, Echo Sharp, and Dragon Egg
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ijU7wk1t3iY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>This is a mod that changes 5 useless items to features. And the items are Beacon, Clock, Heart of Sea, Echo Sharp, and Dragon Egg.

You need this for the mod to work: [geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)

Items Added:

1.beacon ring

2.smartwatch

3.charger

4.baby dragon

5.heart piercer of the deep

6.echo staff

7.beacon ring box

8.smartwatch box

9.villager shop

10.villager shop(structure)

11.Soul

Mob Added:

1.Player

2.baby ender dragon

3.Gohstplayer

beacon ring and smart watch can be crafted and bought from the Villager shop.

You can get soul by killing the warden

You can summon a player or ghost when right-click with the soul

You can recharge your smartwatch by right-clicking the charger

You need a beacon for the beacon ring to work

Shift right to copy all data from the beacon

Right-click heart piercer of the sea to kill all sea entities

Place endstone and then place chorus flower on top and place ender dragon on top to summon the baby ender dragon

Wait 10 for the baby ender dragon to summon

You can ride it and press "b" to shoot a fireball when riding the dragon

Click on the hostile icon in the smartwatch to make all hostile mob glow

Click on the heart icon in the smartwatch to heal yourself but it costs 10 exp

Click on the resistance icon to make yourself immortal if your heart is 5 hp or lower

Press "R" to move down when riding the ender dragon

Press space to go up when riding the ender dragon

Press shift to dismount when riding the ender dragon
